title: Canonical scalar Cech comparison for affine-intersection covers
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $U=(U_i)_{i\in I}$ an open cover, and $F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Assume that every intersection indexed by a nonempty finite tuple is affine. For every $p\in\mathbb N$ there exists a $k$-linear equivalence $e:H^p(\operatorname{picardCechFunctor}(f,U)(F))\to\operatorname{scalarCohomology}(f,F,p)$ [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models, def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. It is canonical in the following precise sense: there exists a canonical module Cech comparison $c$ [def-sc-module-cech-comparison] such that $e(a)=c(M^{-1}S(a))$ for every $a$, where $S$ and $M$ are the explicit additive Cech homology identifications of the scalar presheaf and the global-section-module presheaf. This equality defines the predicate IsPicardScalarCechComparison for any $k$-linear map, without requiring invertibility.

source.place: Tag 01XD (coherent-lemma-cech-cohomology-quasi-coherent), and Cohomology Tag 01EQ (cohomology-lemma-cech-to-cohomology): canonical comparison and scalar restriction.

proof.text: Obtain a canonical module comparison c from cechComparisonMapNaturality. The affine-intersection comparison theorem makes c an isomorphism.

The two additive presheaves are definitionally identical. Under their explicit additive Cech homology identifications S and M, the action of r in k equals the action of scalarMap(f,top)(r) on ordinary module Cech homology: the sectionwise scalar multiplication transformations agree by scalarMap and restriction composition. Apply cechComplexFunctorHomologyIso_hom_smul on both sides and cancel M.

Compose S, inverse M, and c as additive equivalences. The scalar-action equality and linearity of c make this composite k-linear; inverse cancellation gives its inverse and the canonical-comparison equation.

theorem picardScalarCechComparison_exists
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) {ι : Type w} (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : Fin (n + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ e : ((picardCechFunctor f U).obj F).homology p ≃ₗ[k] scalarCohomology f F p,
      IsPicardScalarCechComparison f U F p e
